notes.title: Flash / Ai Health / Chest Rig
notes.content:
Fixed a new bug where players was getting flashed when they shouldn't

Reduced AI health again based of new feedback, current shots to kill below 
[list]
[*] Head = 1 shot  ( No change )
[*] Torso = 2 shots ( No change )
[*] Arms = 2 shots (used to be 3)
[*] Legs = 3 Shots ( No change )
[/list]
Chest Rig Saves/Loading
[list]
[*] Added Primary weapon saves
[*] Your Chest Rig will now save your last holstered primary weapon 
[*] Chest Rigs will start with a set of fully loaded Mags for your primary weapon 
[*] Primary weapon will start with all its lasted used attachments
[*] For safety reasons your primary weapon will start on safety and won't have a round in the chamber.
[/list]

Fixed a bug where the door hit sound would keep being played on a loop till layout change or death.

More updates on the way

notes.title: Throwing, Flashbangs, Grips, Chest Rig & More
notes.content:
[b]Throwing[/b]
[list]
[*] Throwing objects has now been improved; they should now feel a lot more consistent and easier to throw where you want and how far away you want.
[/list]
[b]Flashbangs [/b]
[list]
[*] Improved Flashbang throwing
[*] When flashed, players can now see if they are losing health, giving them a chance to get into cover if they are aware of their surroundings.
[*] Removed painful/annoying ear ringing sound (based on feedback) ( When flashed the sound will still be deafened and will slowly regain back to full hearing.)
[/list]
[b]Grips[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved Glock and Glock Mag grips
[*] Improved Tablet and Tablet Pen grips
[/list]
[b]Chest Rig[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved sidearm holster
[*] Improved taking out zip ties they no longer will get caught on the flashbangs 
[/list]
[b]Performance[/b] 
[list]
[*] Optimized the game for longer play sessions by cleaning up some old used objects both in game and on the backend.
[*] Optimized some things on the backend
[*] Made some improvements to loading
[*] Set the default frame rate to 120 (this will stop players from seeing stutters if there VR headset is on a lower hz rate, before they change there in game setting to match)
[*] Removed frame rate limiters below 72 ( they wasn't needed for players and some people was toggling them on by mistake/without realizing)
[*] Note this isn't meant to be a big optimization update, I just wanted to let people know the changes.
[/list]
[b]Other:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added an extra door to layout 1 to help the flow of the level
[*] Fixed some bugs
[*] More updates are on the way
[/list]

notes.title: Detain Hostages
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42922449/c7659c109a287d209c61f83ca28afb8859f12f8d.png[/img]
Now players can detain civilians

This will bring a new element of tactical decision making, how and when you will detain the civilians?

Note players are not forced to do this, It's just if you want to challenge your skills, even further.

This feature is in its early days so I will be improving this as time goes on. 

As always, more updates are on the way.

Added a New slide to the tutorial for this new feature, but for anyone who doesn't want to walk to the tutorial room here's how it works.

To Detain Hostages:
Touch a civilian's wrist or shoulder area to make them put their hands behind their back.
Grab a zip tie from your chest rig located at the bottom left.
Place the zip tie over their wrists to detain the civilian.

tags.feature: Now players can detain civilians

notes.title: Chest Rig Loading
notes.content:
From now on players who have progressed past the tutorial will always have their chest rig loaded with:
[list]
[*] Three flash bangs ( Current Max )
[*] Side arm in holster ( Loaded with a mag and a round in the chamber )
[*] Two side arm mags ( Current Max )
[/list] I know some people might have wanted primary weapon/mags to be loaded too, but I am hoping this will be a good balance between the fun of choosing/gearing up your kit, while at the same time speeding things up for the player. 

But as always I will be taking notes on the feedback

More updates on the way.

notes.title: Ai improvements with doors
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=SmwACssQ6gI;full][/previewyoutube]
- AI can now be anywhere on the other side of the door even at point blank range
- AI can now open doors anywhere from fully open to slightly open to keep players on their toes
- AI will move throughout the layout even more so keep a steady pace or watch your back!
- Fix a semi rare bug where AI would be slow to track you while aiming when close.
- Ai will now track your movements no matter what IRL movements you are doing.
- General AI movement around Doors has been improved
- Increased the smooth turn rate
More updates on the way keep the feedback coming.
